summary: Module 04 (en) QA done after the lab verification (m04-labs) and the technical review (m04-review). check.mjs: 0 errors, 0 warnings. The page was built and rendered in headless Chromium with KaTeX served locally (the CDN is not reachable from the build machine): no page errors, no KaTeX errors, no unrendered maths, both widgets load, no broken images. All 16 figures were screenshotted and match their captions and the text. Both widgets were driven control by control: gradient-flow-explorer responds to every control; ssm-kernel-explorer's flagged 'unchanged' controls were probed individually and work (the mode sliders act only when their checkbox is on, the select changes the output when given a valid option, and the pole-decay slider is logarithmic). Its numbers agree with an independent calculation (|lambda| = 0.9 gives a half-life of 6.58 steps; recurrence and convolution agree exactly).
changes: plan/module_04.json: the prerequisite $e^{i\theta}$ had lost its backslash to a JSON tab escape and rendered as broken maths; fixed, and check.mjs now reports control characters in plan and metadata text.
issues: Figure captions in this module describe the drawing's layout (for example 'a red dashed arrow runs right to left along the top line') rather than what the reader should take from it; Modules 01-03 use the same style. Not changed.
widget-test.mjs reports changedOutput: false for controls that only act in a mode switched on by a checkbox; the tool, not the widget, is at fault.
